bundle.shortDescription: Play-along piano trainer: MIDI playback with falling notes and sheet music, plus live accuracy feedback.
bundle.longDescription: MidiTrainer is a Windows desktop app that helps you learn piano by playing along with MIDI files. It plays MIDI and karaoke-MIDI songs, listens to you play on a connected MIDI keyboard, and shows falling notes and sheet music with live right/wrong feedback. Follow-you mode keeps the accompaniment at your own tempo, so the music stops when you do, and one-hand practice lets you play a single part while the app covers the rest.
